title: Shelf Reset
shareTitle: Shelf Reset — Put Every Little Thing Home
description: Choose the art, blocks, or nature shelf and match six tactile treasures to their picture homes.
summary: Help Sunny empty the wooden tray, fill three picture-marked cubbies, and make a warm Montessori shelf neat and ready again.
learningGoals: Categorize familiar objects by type and visual match
Build spatial awareness by matching objects to pictured homes
Experience organization as a calm, satisfying care routine
interactionModel: choose one of three shelf cards, then tap or drag each large raster object from the tray into the matching picture-marked cubby
feedbackModel: forgiving no-fail matching, highlighted picture homes, gentle wrong-place recovery, tactile SFX, recorded teacher guidance, visible shelf filling, and a sparkling Sunny celebration

modes.title: Art Shelf
modes.skill: match brushes, paint jars, and art tools

modes.title: Nature Shelf
modes.skill: match leaves, pinecones, and small nature treasures
